name: 02-character-select
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Premium polished videogame UI concept for Virtual Runners, a joyful 1990s anime side-scrolling runner with existing cel-painted chibi characters. Brand '晴空跑道': bright open SKY, CLOUD WHITE and SUNSHINE ORANGE. Palette #23B5E8, #116F95, #FF8A3D, #FFFFFF, #ECF8FC, dark text #163A4B, reward yellow #F5C949. Rounded wayfinding signs, circular route nodes, pill-shaped distance markers, thin deep-lake-blue outlines and soft short shadows. Clear spacious hierarchy, large readable Traditional Chinese, functional consistent UI. Flat cel colors, no chrome or metallic letters, no black brush panels, no volleyball/sports-team shield, no navy-gold theme, no app-store ad/purchases, no floating confetti everywhere. Clean typography, no illegible tiny labels. Full-bleed landscape 16:9 screen, preferably 1920x1080 or higher, no device frame. Reference1 visual language, reference2 EXACT roster identities in order top row xiaocui,yuehua,aming,tangtang,xiaochun; bottom row lanjie,cangya,jinye,leo,alie. Reference3 selected runner Xiaocui exact outfit. Create full game CHARACTER SELECT screen. Top-left small round back arrow and title '選擇跑者', top-right small pill '關卡模式'. Left-middle 55%: large Xiaocui sprinting right over a curved blue route stripe, full body, emerald twin ponytails pink bows sailor white-and-teal top pink bow teal skirt teal sneakers. Right-middle clean white rounded capability panel: large '小翠', subtitle '幸運磁鐵', magnet icon and clear sentence '附近的金幣會自己飛過來。'. Bottom-right large orange CTA '選擇關卡' with arrow. Lower-left/middle: neatly organized TWO ROWS of portrait tiles, exactly 11 slots total, row1 SIX slots Xiaocui,Yuehua,Aming,Tangtang,Xiaochun,Lanjie; row2 FIVE slots Cangya,Jinye,Leo,Alie,one dark silhouette LOCK slot. Use the provided roster faces with distinctive colors and accessories, selected Xiaocui has orange highlight and cyan focus outline; lock slot stays anonymous, no Ayi reveal. Do not invent character stats, no ability meters, no currency, no team slots, no 1P-4P strips, no VS. Small bottom hints '返回' '確認'. Plenty breathing room, no scenery behind text. Full polished screenshot, not a collage of screens.
